model: RISH Delta Energy NX multifunction energy meter
applies_to: Rishabh RISH Delta Energy NX panel energy meters with RS-485 Modbus RTU, per the operating manual on the product page (standard CT version).
summary: The RISH Delta Energy NX is a 96 x 96 mm multifunction energy meter for 1-phase and 3-phase networks with an RS-485 Modbus RTU port. Every value is an IEEE 754 float in two registers: measurements are input registers (FC04) from 30001 and are mirrored as holding registers at 40001+, while setup parameters sit at 46003-46085. This map covers voltages, currents, power, PF, frequency, energy, demand, THD, run hours and the setup block.

addressing.note: The manual prints 3X/4X register numbers. Wire address = number - 30001 (FC04) or - 40001 (FC03/FC16): the Volts 3 example (30005) starts at 00 04, and the system-type example (46003) starts at 17 72 (6002).

source.title: Operating Manual Rish Delta Energy NX
source.pages: PDF pp. 32-36 (data format, Table 4 3X registers), pp. 39-46 (4X examples, Table 5, explanations, Table 6 RS485 set-up code, Tables 7-9)

notes: The data-format table states IEEE 754 floats, most significant byte first; the Volts 3 example returns 43 5B 41 21 (219.25 V), so ABCD is the default. 46049 can switch to reversed order.
Every 3X value can also be read with FC03 at the same number plus 10000 (30001 -> 40001); only the 3X copies are listed.
The register table has no unit column, so units are left blank. Energy registers follow 46017 (Wh/kWh/MWh, default kWh).

Left out: min/max history (31301-31433), the long-energy block (30801-30853) and the user-assignable registers (35201-35239). Availability per wiring type (3P4W, 3P3W, 1P3W, 1P2W) is marked in the manual; per-phase power rows are not available on 3P3W.
Demand time (46015) is printed as '1 to 60 seconds' in Table 5 and 'minutes' in the explanation, so no unit is given.
Up to 20 parameters per read request.
A separate manual covers the RJ12 CT variant (Delta Energy NX RJ12); its 3X table matches this one but it is not covered by this file.

registers.name: Wh import (update-rate)
registers.description: Energy refreshed at the 46021 update rate.

registers.name: PT primary
registers.description: Max 1200 kV L-L (also limited by 1000 MVA per phase); default 415.

registers.name: Energy digit reset count
registers.description: Energy rolls over after this many digits.

registers.name: Energy update rate
registers.description: 1-60 min, for the update-rate energy registers.

registers.name: Register order / word order
registers.description: Write 2141.0 in the wanted order to switch normal/reversed float word order.

registers.name: Pulse/limit 1 parameter select
registers.description: Parameter number per manual Table 2 (limit) or Table 7 (pulse).

registers.name: Limit 1 hysteresis
registers.description: Percent; printed as 0-50 % in Table 5 and 0.5-50 % in the text; default 50.

integration.summary: Read 30001-30090 with FC04 in blocks of up to 40 registers and decode each pair as a big-endian float. Energy units follow 46017. Settings are floats at 46003+ written with FC16.
integration.enable: Set the Modbus address (46047, default 1) and Comsetup code (46045, default 8 = 9600 8N1) from the front panel or over Modbus.
quirks: All setup values are floats too: system type 3 reads back as 40 40 00 00.
Reading or writing half a float returns exception 02.
If a password is set, write it to 46033 before changing setup registers.
setup: Comsetup (46045) packs baud 2400-57600, parity and stop bits into one code; see the value list.
gotchas: The energy unit and digit-rollover settings change how energy registers must be scaled and when they wrap.

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
